title: Harden creature attack/action source parsing and alternate-mode representation
description:
Repair demonstrated creature attack/action parser failures: alternate/swarm modes,
parenthetical bonuses, Unicode minus, swallowed action boundaries, nonstandard ranges,
inconsistent damage shapes, and truncated target qualifiers. An exhaustive attack/action
inventory is a source-fidelity claim only when source stat-block structure independently
establishes the denominator.
design:
2026-10-09 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main 6f57be85). Lane A, profile rules-clause-complete. Creature attack mechanics (mechanics.attacks[].hitDamage, mechanics.damage) are source projections for discovery/adjudication; no deterministic capability consumes creature hitDamage today (verify with grep before relying on it), so this is source fidelity.
DEFECT CLASSES (all in parseAttack / parseDamage, packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts ~L84-100, ~L372-406):
 C1 Unicode minus (opus:F-29): parseDamage's dice grammar accepts only ASCII [+-]; 'Hit: 1 (1d4 − 1) piercing damage' (U+2212) yields no damage at all, and the flat-damage fallback also fails, so hitDamage is EMPTY. Population by query: every record whose text contains /\d+d\d+\s*−\s*\d+/ (snapshot: 18 creatures incl. awakened-shrub, baboon, bat, frog, giant-fire-beetle, hawk, kobold, owl, quipper, rat, raven, scorpion, sea-horse, spider, swarm-of-quippers/rats/ravens, weasel; magic-items deck-of-illusions, ioun-stone, ring-of-spell-storing - check those items' own projections render the printed value, repair only if a value is lost or altered). Normalize U+2212 to '-' in the dice expression consistently (the printed dice string in `dice` should use ASCII ' - ' like ' + '), and also accept U+2212 in attack bonuses ('[+−-]\d+ to hit') and every other shared numeric grammar in this file that reads signed modifiers (search the file for '[+-]' character classes and fix siblings; list them).
 C2 Parenthetical alternate attack bonus (opus:F-28): 'Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft.' breaks the attack lead-in regex, so creature:druid Quarterstaff and creature:dryad Club have NO attacks[] and only a flattened damage list. Accept an optional '(<+N> to hit <condition>)' after the bonus and carry it on the matching alternative (C3).
 C3 Mutually exclusive damage alternatives flattened into cumulative arrays: in the 'Hit:' clause, ', or N (XdY + Z) <type> damage <condition>' is an ALTERNATIVE to the preceding damage, but hitDamage (and top-level mechanics.damage) list both as if cumulative (e.g. creature:drider Longsword hitDamage [1d8+3, 1d10+3] slashing). Population by query (snapshot 27 clauses): 'if used with two hands to make a melee attack' 9, 'if used with two hands' 6, 'if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer' 6, 'with shillelagh' 2, 'while enlarged' 2, 'at range' 1, 'in Small or Medium form' 1.
REPRESENTATION DECISION: attacks[i].hitDamage = the DEFAULT mode only (the first damage plus any trailing 'plus N (XdY) <type> damage' riders that apply to every mode, e.g. Azer's fire). attacks[i].alternatives = [{ condition: '<verbatim condition text>', hitDamage: [complete damage list for that mode, including shared riders], attackBonus?: N (only when the source prints a mode-specific bonus, e.g. shillelagh +4) }]. Top-level mechanics.damage on such an entry equals the default mode (so nothing reads cumulative). Condition text stays verbatim; no condition is interpreted. Entries without an alternative are byte-identical.
F-31 (ranged-notation): currently no ranged weapon/spell attack lacks rangeFeet; verify the alternate notations present in the corpus ('range 30/120 ft.', 'reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.', 'range 120 ft.' single value for spell attacks) all project; repair only if any is lost, and record the result.
CAP-004 (creature-statblock-mechanics, 'Creature stat-block mechanics are complete'): narrowed under ADR 0020 (no completeness claim); surviving obligation = emitted creature attack/damage projections agree with the printed stat block (this repair + existing statline fidelity gate).
CROSS-KIND (absorbed from retired 19.1.2): the same printed grammar must not project differently by kind; search spell, magic-item, equipment, hazard text for U+2212 dice and '(<+N> to hit ...)' and ', or N (XdY) ... damage <condition>' forms; repair or disposition each sibling with a source-backed reason in the report.
REGISTRY: druid-dryad-attacks (F-28), unicode-minus-damage (F-29), ranged-notation (F-31) stay accepted with reasoning naming this repair (F-31: verified, no loss); creature-statblock-mechanics (CAP-004) -> narrowed. damage-alternatives (F-27) is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1; add a sentence to the 19.3.1 bead notes (not the registry) that creature attack alternatives were repaired here, so 19.3.1 handles only its remaining option-local scope.
EVIDENCE: one new test file: (a) generalized invariant over the real pack: for every creature entry with an 'X Weapon/Spell Attack: ... Hit:' lead-in, attacks[] exists, attackBonus equals the printed bonus, and every printed damage expression in the Hit clause appears exactly once across hitDamage + alternatives (independent predicate in the test); (b) no projected dice string contains U+2212 and no record with a printed U+2212 dice expression has empty hitDamage; (c) exact source-fidelity regressions: druid Quarterstaff (default 1d6, alternatives two-hands 1d8 and shillelagh +4 1d8+2), drider Longsword, azer Warhammer (fire rider in both modes), a swarm half-HP case, baboon Bite 1d4 - 1. Update existing expectations only where this design proves them wrong; state preserves/strengthens/replaces.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every attack/action in the independently enumerated source structural population is represented with correct boundary and source values.
- Unicode minus, alternate range notation, and parenthetical alternate bonuses cannot silently erase printed values.
- Mutually exclusive modes remain alternatives, not cumulative arrays.
- Target qualifiers and source relationships survive projection.
- Passing this parser census does not prove complete creature mechanics or universal deterministic support.

2026-10-09 pre-implementation probe (Claude Captain, main a961fb0b): F-29 STILL LIVE - creature entries printing 'Hit: N (XdY − Z)' with U+2212 minus lose hitDamage entirely (awakened-shrub Rake, baboon Bite, giant-fire-beetle Bite ...; 9 creature entries contain U+2212 before a digit, some are non-damage penalties like black-pudding Corrosive Form which is already typed -1). F-28 STILL LIVE - creature:druid Quarterstaff has no attacks[] and three cumulative damage entries (1d6 / 1d8 versatile / 1d8+2 shillelagh) i.e. alternatives flattened; creature:dryad Club same shape (1d4 / 1d8+4 shillelagh). F-31: no ranged weapon/spell attack entry currently lacks a range projection (check alternate notation siblings across kinds before closing). Cross-kind sibling search (spell, magic-item, equipment, hazard) for U+2212 and alternate notation is required per the 2026-10-09 note.
